context: Naoko sits with Sachiko looking at old family albums.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: おばあちゃん、この写真、家族、皆、若いね。
lines.en: Grandma, look at this photo — the whole family, everyone looks so young.
lines.style: Warm observation, gentle nostalgia threading through the words. Slight smile in the voice. Unhurried pace, letting the memory land. Soft reverence for what was.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 昔ね。思い出、たくさん、ある。
lines.en: It was a long time ago. I have so many memories.
lines.style: Soft, unhurried delivery. Voice carries the weight of decades without heaviness. Slight pause before "memories" — gathering them. Trailing off gently into the past.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 一緒の時間、本当に、大切だね。
lines.en: Being together like that — it really was something precious.
lines.style: Quiet realization in the middle of the sentence. Gentle emphasis on "precious" without pushing. Voice opens slightly, then settles. Sincere, not performing.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: これからも、皆で、過ごそうね。
lines.en: Let's all keep spending time together like this, going forward.
lines.style: Hopeful but grounded. Warm, steady delivery. Slight lift at the end — invitation, not demand. The voice of someone who has learned what matters most.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 楽しい思い出、また、作ろうね。
lines.en: Let's make more happy memories together, okay?
lines.style: Gentle invitation, almost conspiratorial in its warmth. Slight softness on the opening word. Unhurried, as if speaking to someone she loves. Closing with quiet affection.
